description:
Introducing the all-new DK Zenith Disc race frame. Built on the same proven low-profile geometry as the DK Professional frame for max speed and stability. Made to accelerate. Engineered for winning.

100% custom design constructed from 6000 series hydroformed aluminum. Patent pending sliding flat mount disc brake system delivers superior braking in all conditions. Clean, compact, responsive, and stiff. Wide stance rear end is designed for max power.

Details

Pro 20.5”, XL 21”, XX 21.5”, XXX 22”, XXXX 22.5” and Cruiser 21.75” sizes

Built with lightweight hydroformed 6000 series aluminum tubing

Horizontal sliding axle / brake system provides 30mm of adjustment

Features a tapered 1-1/8”-1.5” head tube (headset included with an extra lower race to work with standard 1-1/8” forks)

Trapezoidal seat mast for increased stiffness at bottom bracket

Wide stance rear stay design adds stiffness

Threaded Euro bottom bracket shell

Internal brake cable routing

20mm / 15mm / 10mm dropouts (all axle hardware included) with integrated chain tensioners

Seat post diameter: 27.2mm

NOTE: The DK Zenith Disc frame is compatible with flat mount disc brakes only. Flat mount is more compact and lighter than post mount. With flat mount, the rear caliper affixed with two bolts running through a flattened frame surface and then threading directly into the caliper (or an adapter affixed to the caliper).
